events.title: Indian Shares Stage Late Recovery To End Modestly Higher
events.description: Indian shares fluctuated before finishing modestly higher on Friday, as a sell-off in government debt eased and oil prices retreated from recent highs following reports that Iran has submitted a proposal to the United States to end their war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days.

events.title: Gold Edges Higher As Oil Prices And Yields Ease
events.description: Gold prices rose toward $4,300 an ounce on Friday as a sell-off in government debt eased and oil prices retreated from recent highs following reports that Iran has submitted a proposal to the United States to end their war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days.

events.title: Oil Prices Ease On US-Iran Breakthrough Hopes
events.description: Oil prices retreated from recent highs on Friday following reports that Iran has submitted a proposal to the United States to end their war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days.

events.title: European Shares Edge Higher On US-Iran Truce Hopes
events.description: European stocks advanced on Friday and were on course for a weekly gain as a sell-off in government debt eased and oil prices retreated from recent highs following reports that Iran has submitted a proposal to the United States to end their war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days.

events.title: Asian Shares Mixed In Thin Holiday Trade
events.description: Asian stocks ended mixed in thin trade on Friday, with markets in South Korea, Taiwan and mainland China closed for public holidays.

events.title: German GfK Consumer Sentiment To Fall
events.description: German consumer confidence is set to fall in October as rising energy prices dragged down income expectations, monthly survey results of the NIM Consumer Climate powered by GfK showed Friday. The forward-looking consumer sentiment index fell more-than-expected to -30.6 in October from -26.8 in September. The score was seen at -27.1.

events.title: Canadian Dollar Falls Against Majors
events.description: The Canadian dollar weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Friday.

events.title: European Shares Seen Steady At Open
events.description: European stocks are seen opening higher on Friday after U.S. markets recovered from earlier losses to end little changed overnight on hopes for a resumption of U.S.-Iran talks.

events.title: Indian Shares Struggle For Direction In Early Trade
events.description: Indian shares were little changed in early trade on Friday after falling sharply in the previous session on concerns over rising oil prices and bond yields in international markets.

events.title: Australian Market Maintains Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is maintaining its early losses in mid-market moves on Friday, extending the losses in the previous session, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling well below the 8,700 level, with weakness in mining, energy and technology stocks partially offset by gains in financial stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mixed
events.description: Asian stock markets are trading mixed on Friday, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight, as continued surge in crude oil prices and bond yields raise concerns about inflation risk and interest rate hikes. The lack of clarity about peace talks for the resolution of the Middle East conflict is also weighing on market sentiment. Asian markets ended mostly lower on Thursday.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Tad Higher At Open
events.description: Indian shares look set to open higher on Friday after a heavy sell-off in the previous session.

events.title: Thai Stock Market May See Continued Consolidation
events.description: The Thai stock market on Thursday wrote a finish to the five-day winning streak in which it had jumped almost 50 points or 3.1 percent. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,600-point plateau and it's likely to open to the downside again on Friday.
